$comment: Shared storage defaults for every Dash Forge client: forge-core (and through it dg, git-remote-dash, forge-relay) embeds this file with include_str!, and forge-web imports it. The gateways are only ever byte sources. Every read is SHA-256-verified against the on-chain packManifest, so a gateway that lies or disappears costs a retry, never integrity. Users override the list in ~/.config/dash-forge/storage.toml ([read] ipfs_gateways). The Forge project operates none of these.
